caption: The drawing depicts the upper façade of a building with a distinct bell gable structure, rendered in grayscale. The composition features three horizontal levels, each with arched openings. The lowest visible level has two large arches; the middle level has three smaller arches with more solid wall space between them, while the top level has a single, centered arched opening under a rounded pediment. The upper two-thirds of the façade displays a stucco or plastered texture with smooth shading, whereas the lower section is densely filled with a detailed illustration of brickwork. Below the drawing, there is a hand-drawn ribbon banner containing the year "1771" on the left side and the inscription "mission san gabriel arcangel" in lowercase script across the lower center, with "F. F. Jonas" written near the end of the banner. The overall color is monochromatic, using only shades of gray and black on an off-white background.
title: Mision San Gabriel Arcangel
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
